scripts.dev:kill-ports: (npx kill-port 4000 || true) && (npx kill-port 3002 || true) && (npx kill-port 3010 || true) && (npx kill-port 3011 || true) && (npx kill-port 3020 || true)
scripts.dev:api:start: npm run build --workspace @blobinfini/database && npm run dev --workspace @blobinfini/api
scripts.dev:api: npx kill-port 4000 || true && npm run dev:api:start
scripts.dev:web: npx kill-port 3002 || true && npm run dev:web:start
scripts.dev:all: npm run dev:kill-ports && npm-run-all -p dev:api:start dev:web:start
scripts.dev:web:nokill: cd apps/web && cross-env-shell "NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=${NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL:-http://localhost:4000} PORT=${PORT:-3010} npx next dev -p ${PORT:-3010}"
scripts.dev:infra: docker compose up -d postgres redis minio mailpit
scripts.dev:all:docker: npm run dev:infra && concurrently -n web,api -c magenta,blue "npm:dev:web" "npm:dev:api:docker"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @blobinfini/api && npm run build --workspace @blobinfini/database
scripts.build:web: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace @blobinfini/web
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --workspace @blobinfini/api && npm run type-check --workspace @blobinfini/web
scripts.//: ⚠️  DO NOT use type-check:legacy in CI. Use workspace-specific scripts instead: npm run type-check -w @blobinfini/web && npm run type-check -w @blobinfini/api
scripts.prepare: (cd packages/database && npx prisma generate) && (npm run build --workspace @blobinfini/database || true)
scripts.fix:perms: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules && rm -f package-lock.json apps/*/package-lock.json packages/*/package-lock.json && npm cache clean --force && npm install
scripts.fix:perms:sudo: sudo chown -R $(whoami) ~/.npm && sudo chown -R $(whoami) ./ && npm run fix:perms
